item.title: Chainflip Suspects Key Theft in $12.6 Million Vault Hack
item.description: The first report identifies validly signed transfers outside the protocol but leaves parts of the suspected key theft unconfirmed. Services remain paused.
item.content:encoded: The first report identifies validly signed transfers outside the protocol but leaves parts of the suspected key theft unconfirmed. Services remain paused.

item.title: Cyber Bridge Hack Followed LayerZero's Support Exit
item.description: AstraSec said 5.213 million unbacked CYBER were minted. LayerZero's CEO suspects Cyber's replacement infrastructure was compromised.
item.content:encoded: AstraSec said 5.213 million unbacked CYBER were minted. LayerZero's CEO suspects Cyber's replacement infrastructure was compromised.

item.title: Reuters: Circle, World Liberty Ordered to Keep Tokens Frozen
item.description: An ADGM order requires 18 firms to preserve Binance hack-linked tokens, Reuters reported. A Dec. 1 hearing will consider whether the restrictions continue.
item.content:encoded: An ADGM order requires 18 firms to preserve Binance hack-linked tokens, Reuters reported. A Dec. 1 hearing will consider whether the restrictions continue.

item.title: Stake DAO Warns of Forum Breach, Says Funds Unaffected
item.description: The copied database may contain emails, hashed passwords, 2FA secrets and private messages. Stake DAO urged forum users to reset access and watch for phishing.
item.content:encoded: The copied database may contain emails, hashed passwords, 2FA secrets and private messages. Stake DAO urged forum users to reset access and watch for phishing.

item.title: Wiz Says Attacker Mined AI Coding Histories for Logins
item.description: Wiz matched cloud-intrusion telemetry with an attacker's exposed files, which also revealed broader credential harvesting.
